name: winapp
description: WinApp extension for Visual Studio Code to assist in building, debugging, and packaging Windows applications. Includes schema-aware IntelliSense for AppxManifest.xml files.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace, WinUI XAML provides syntax highlighting only. The language server does not run, so IntelliSense, diagnostics, navigation, and formatting are unavailable until you trust the workspace. All other winapp extension features are unaffected.

winapp.appDirectories.description: Relative paths (from the workspace root) to app project directories. When set, WinApp commands target these directories instead of auto-scanning. If multiple entries are provided, you'll be prompted to choose.

winapp.manifest.intelliSense.enable.description: Enable IntelliSense (completion, hover, diagnostics, and Go to Definition/navigation) for AppxManifest.xml files.

winapp.manifest.diagnostics.level.description: Diagnostic filter for manifest schema validation. Set to 'off' to disable validation, 'warning' to show all diagnostics, or 'error' to show only errors.

winapp.manifest.intelliSense.diagnostics.description: When enabled, report known manifest elements that appear under an unexpected parent even when substitution-group coverage is incomplete.

inputFolder.description: Path to the build output folder containing your app binaries (e.g., '${workspaceFolder}/bin/Debug/net8.0-windows10.0.22621'). If not set, you will be prompted to select a folder.

manifest.description: Path to the AppxManifest.xml file. If not set, the CLI auto-detects from the input folder or current directory.

debuggerType.description: Optional override for the underlying debugger to use. Omit to let WinApp reuse an installed debugger or prompt you to pick one ('coreclr', 'cppvsdbg', or 'node').

args.description: Command-line arguments to pass to the application

outputAppxDirectory.description: Output directory for the loose layout package. If not specified, a directory named AppX inside the input folder will be used.

configurationSnippets.label: WinApp: Launch and Attach
configurationSnippets.description: Launch a WinApp package and attach the debugger

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run sync-schemas && npm run verify-schemas && npm run package && node scripts/ensure-server-bundle.mjs
scripts.build: npm run compile-tsc && npm run compile && npm run build:server:debug
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tsc && npm run lint && npm run compile && npm run build:server:debug && npm run restore:fixture
scripts.build:server:debug: dotnet build server/src/WinUiXaml.LanguageServer/WinUiXaml.LanguageServer.csproj -c Debug --nologo && dotnet build server/src/WinUiXaml.DotnetHost/WinUiXaml.DotnetHost.csproj -c Debug --nologo
scripts.test:server: dotnet test server/test/WinUiXaml.Xaml.Tests/WinUiXaml.Xaml.Tests.csproj -c Debug --nologo && dotnet test server/test/WinUiXaml.Workspace.Tests/WinUiXaml.Workspace.Tests.csproj -c Debug --nologo && dotnet test server/test/WinUiXaml.LanguageServer.Tests/WinUiXaml.LanguageServer.Tests.csproj -c Debug --nologo
scripts.test:xaml-smoke: npm run build:server:debug && npm run restore:fixture && node server/test/lsp-smoke/smoke.mjs
scripts.clean: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('bin', {recursive: true, force: true}); require('fs').rmSync('out', {recursive: true, force: true}); require('fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true});"
scripts.verify-schemas: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'),d=p.join(__dirname,'schemas');if(!fs.existsSync(d)||fs.readdirSync(d).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.xsd')).length===0){console.error('ERROR: schemas/ contains no XSD files. Run npm run sync-schemas first.');process.exit(1);}console.log('schemas/ verified:',fs.readdirSync(d).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.xsd')).length,'XSD files');"
scripts.test:unit: tsc -p ./ && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('src/test/fixtures','out/test/fixtures',{recursive:true})" && mocha out/test/project-detection.test.js && node --test scripts/test/server-delivery.test.mjs && npx tsx --test src/test/artifact-types.test.ts src/test/arch-detection.test.ts src/test/asset-copy-token-store.test.ts src/test/csharp-dev-kit-notification.test.ts src/test/debugger-resolver.test.ts src/test/extension-field-validator.test.ts src/test/extension-templates.test.ts src/test/manifest-edge-cases.test.ts src/test/manifest-parser.test.ts src/test/manifest-path.test.ts src/test/manifest-validator.test.ts src/test/project-resolver.test.ts src/test/redos-prevention.test.ts src/test/xml-utils.test.ts src/test/shell-escape.test.ts src/test/noop-debug-adapter.test.ts src/test/pack-result.test.ts src/test/sign-utils.test.ts src/test/sign-flow.test.ts src/test/tool-command-utils.test.ts src/test/xsd-parser.test.ts src/test/xml-context.test.ts src/test/intellisense-integration.test.ts src/test/intellisense-validation.test.ts src/test/schema-shared.test.ts src/test/semantic-validation.test.ts src/test/working-directory.test.ts src/test/xaml-degraded-notification.test.ts src/test/xaml-server-architecture.test.ts src/test/xaml-server-lifecycle.test.ts
